title: An Alabama Map Headline: What It Says and What We Add
description: Does a short headline commit a fallacy, or do readers supply the faulty argument? Test an Alabama redistricting headline against the court record.
intro: A source-checked case with a try-it-first exercise, a qualified verdict, three hypothetical reasoning traps, and a correction to our original analysis.

title: A Voting Screen Shows the Wrong Name. Does That Establish Rigging?
description: Do reported touchscreen voting problems establish deliberate election rigging? Separate the experience, possible causes, and the scope of the claim.
intro: Examine a reported warning, reconstruct its strongest reading, and test the gap between a voting-screen problem and a claim of intentional rigging.
